title: SoD Modern deterministic dialogue creation request v1
description: A source-only, anchor-based request to create one Mount & Blade 1.011 dialogue route. The Composer canonicalizes rendering, rejects duplicate route signatures, and blocks static NPC first-match hazards unless explicitly acknowledged.

anchor_route_id.description: Stable route ID returned by dialogue_find; fixes the source fragment and insertion neighborhood.

speaker.description: Symbolic M&B speaker expression, for example anyone or plyr.

allow_static_shadow.description: Must remain false unless the caller has deliberately reviewed a static NPC first-match hazard.

shadow_acknowledgement.const: I acknowledge that an earlier NPC route may shadow this new route.
